atmospheric_profiles.construction_method: For the distinct copied AM 12.2 family, 25 AMC files cross annual/DJF/MAM/JJA/SON with H2O percentiles 5/25/50/75/95. They cite MERRA-2 inst3_3d_asm_Np v5.12.4, 2007-2016, per-pressure-level H2O percentiles and median O3, and contain complete pressure-layer bytes. Post-hoc P1 varied only Nscale troposphere h2o and directly ran all 100 target/profile fitted-scale grids; it narrows numerical recipes but does not establish the historical profile mapping or an independent physical intermediate-profile rule. For its correction metric, q25/q50/q75 candidate tau is direct AM atmTaun while generic truth tau is reconstructed as -log(atmTtx); q95 reconstructs both nominal ratio sides as -log(Tband/T225). The frozen P1 report/manifest's broader tau wording is superseded by this package-level clarification. Mapping to the four generic q artifacts remains unestablished.
atmospheric_profiles.historical_source_evidence: The copied annual/seasonal AM 12.2 profiles and their construction comments are complete and digest-bound. TolTECA registry identity proves the copied seasonal and annual products are separate from generic am_q25/am_q50/am_q75/am_q95, so the exact generic-q profile choice or scale remains unresolved. P1's exact anchors and post-hoc rank-one recipes close no custody, missing-q95, independent-profile, spectral-choice, or operational-domain fact. The owner may either recover the generic-q custody and q95 bytes (recommended faithful-lineage closure) or approve a separately versioned AM 12.2 successor while retaining that historical custody gap as unresolved; the successor must not be represented as a regeneration of the generic products.
